result.stderr:
Usage: metalama-mcp [--timeout <seconds>] [--editor-link <template>|none] [--no-http]

A local MCP server that communicates over stdio only. Results in the html format are served on a random loopback port, unless --no-http is given. Register it with an MCP client, for example:
  claude mcp add metalama -- dnx Metalama.Mcp
